title: Act: Add phaser dependency, createGame factory, game config and PhaserHost
summary: Install Phaser 3.90 and add the host component, config builder and factory.
description: Context: no Phaser code exists. Implement the dependency, a testable factory, config with pixel-art settings and a lifecycle-safe host component. Expected result: PhaserHost renders a div container and owns one game instance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the package manifest, When read, Then phaser is ^3.90.0.
Given PhaserHost source, When read, Then it guards creation with a ref and destroys in effect cleanup.

steps.action: Add the dependency "phaser": "^3.90.0" to the dependencies object, then run npm install in game/frontend to update package-lock.json.
steps.expected: package.json lists phaser ^3.90.0 and node_modules/phaser/package.json version starts with 3.90.

steps.action: Create the file. Export GAME_WIDTH=640 and GAME_HEIGHT=360. Export computeZoom(w:number,h:number,dpr:number):number returning Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.min(w*dpr/GAME_WIDTH, h*dpr/GAME_HEIGHT))). Export buildGameConfig(parent:HTMLElement, scenes: Phaser.Types.Scenes.SceneType[]): Phaser.Types.Core.GameConfig with type Phaser.AUTO, parent, width GAME_WIDTH, height GAME_HEIGHT, render {pixelArt:true, roundPixels:true, antialias:false}, scale {mode: Phaser.Scale.FIT, autoCenter: Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH}, scene scenes.
steps.expected: buildGameConfig returns a config with render.pixelArt true and scale.mode Phaser.Scale.FIT.

steps.action: Create the file exporting createGame(parent:HTMLElement, scenes): Phaser.Game that returns new Phaser.Game(buildGameConfig(parent, scenes)). This is the single seam tests mock.
steps.expected: createGame is the only place new Phaser.Game is called.

steps.action: Create PhaserHost with props {scenes?: Phaser.Types.Scenes.SceneType[]}. Use containerRef (div) and gameRef (useRef<Phaser.Game|null>(null)). In a useEffect with [] deps: if gameRef.current is null and containerRef.current exists, set gameRef.current = createGame(containerRef.current, scenes ?? []). Create a ResizeObserver on the container whose callback calls gameRef.current?.scale.refresh(). The cleanup disconnects the observer, calls gameRef.current?.destroy(true), and sets gameRef.current = null. Render <div ref={containerRef} className="h-full w-full" data-testid="phaser-host" />.
steps.expected: Mounting creates one game, unmounting destroys it and nulls the ref.
